name: Juffing Hotel & Spa
beschreibung: The 4-star superior Juffing Hotel & Spa is perched on a scenic high plateau in Hinterthiersee above Kufstein. Widely acclaimed for its adults-focused tranquility, the hotel provides a soothing haven for discerning couples and wellness connoisseurs. The lavish spa and wellness domain features year-round heated indoor and outdoor swimming pools, diverse designer saunas, sunlit relaxation lounges with libraries, and panorama vistas over the Kaisergebirge peaks. Its certified organic gourmet cuisine showcases refined natural dishes crafted from local produce. Walking paths and bike trails start at the doorstep in summer, while winter brings scenic snowshoeing and cross-country skiing.
kurzbeschreibung: Award-winning 4-star superior spa hotel in Hinterthiersee featuring luxury wellness and views of the Wilder Kaiser.
